Category: Internship Programme. Description: UNIDO Internship Programme Are you ready to make a difference in the world while gaining valuable professional experience? The UNIDO internship programme offers motivated students and recent graduates the opportunity to Contribute to inclusive and sustainable industrial development in a dynamic, multicultural environment. With placements at our Headquarters in Vienna and field offices worldwide, interns gain hands-on exposure to international cooperation, policy, and development work. Join us and take the first step toward a meaningful global career. How to apply? Internship opportunities are regularly published on the UNIDO Careers Portal. To apply, simply explore the current listings and submit your application online for the position that best aligns with your interests and qualifications. You can find details on different internship areas and eligibility requirements for applicants here.. This category currently has 1 open positions.
Learn more about Internship Programme opportunities at UNIDO by visiting the official information page.

Category: ​​​Information for Member States and Permanent Missions. Description: This page is designed to support informed engagement by Permanent Missions with UNIDO’s Division of Human Resource Management with an emphasis on its recruitment and outreach efforts. It provides a concise entry point to the principles that guide recruitment, the official sources of information, and the pathways through which Member States can help connect qualified talent to UNIDO opportunities. Its purpose is not only to inform, but also to encourage practical engagement by enabling Permanent Missions to understand our processes, share accurate vacancy information and promote awareness of UNIDO career opportunities among relevant audiences. The following page provides the framework and reference context that supports this engagement. Further details can be obtained via UNIDO’s official careers page here. This category currently has 0 open positions.
